author: GitHub
description:
As AI tools evolve, many developers feel like they are mourning the craft of manually writing software. In this clip from the GitHub Podcast, the team discusses the blog post "We mourn our craft" and explores whether traditional coding skills are truly losing their value. While viral social media takes push extreme viewpoints, many engineering teams still rely on hand-written code. Watch the full episode to hear more perspectives on developer culture and AI.
